senses.gloss: f. (שׂוּם, formed with ref. to שום תשים, Deut. XVII, 15) appointment, office.—Pl. מְשִׂימוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 45b:9">Yeb. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מ׳ שאתה משים וכ׳</he> whatever offices thou createst, the elected must be from among thy brethren; <cite ref="Kiddushin 76b:10">Kidd. 76ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
